Na vseh direktnih avtobusih (št. 14006, 17006, 31006, 35006 in 36006 ter št. 51206, 52306 in 52606), ki nadomeščajo vlake višje vrste (ICS, IC) je na omenjeni relaciji potrebno plačilo dodatka za vlake višje vrste. Več informacij.  Za preverjanje možnosti prevoza oseb na invalidskih vozičkih prosimo, da vsaj 24 ur pred želenim potovanjem pokličete 01 291 33 91. Več informacij o prevozu oseb z omejeno mobilnostjo.  Na omenjenih avtobusih ni mogoč prevoz koles in živali. Izjema so psi vodniki, psi pomočniki in službeni psi. Pri nadomestnih prevozih lahko nastajajo zamude, kar prosimo upoštevajte pri načrtovanju potovanja.  Lokacija postanka nadomestnega avtobusnega prevoza na železniški postaji Ljubljana: Nova Avtobusna postaja Ljubljana (peroni 37, 38 in 39) - Lokacija na zemljevidu in Zemljevid Avtobusne postaje Ljubljana  Potnikom se opravičujemo in zahvaljujemo za razumevanje.  potniski.sz.si/info  Na portalu MOJ VLAK se lahko naročite na samodejno obveščanje (prek brezplačnih sporočil SMS) o dogodkih na progi in morebitnih spremembah voženj vlakov v notranjem prometu. Več informacij.

alerts.headerText: Buses replace trains: Ljubljana - Celje and vice versa (13/12/2026 - 14/3/2027).
alerts.descriptionText: Link: Buses replacement timetable  Buses replace trains mentioned in the link above on Ljubljana - Celje route 13 December 2026 - 14 March 2027.  On all direct buses (No. 14006, 17006, 31006, 35006 and 36006, as well as No. 51206, 52306 and 52606) replacing higher-type trains (ICS, IC), an additional surcharge for higher-category trains must be paid on the specified route. More information.  For wheelchair transport availability, please call +386 1 291 33 91 at least 24 hours before your desired journey. More information on transport for persons with reduced mobility.  Bicycles and animals cannot be transported on the mentioned buses. Exceptions are guide dogs, assistance dogs, and service dogs. Delays may occur with rail replacement bus services, so please take this into account when planning your journey.  Location of the rail replacement bus stop at Ljubljana Railway Station: New Ljubljana Bus Station (platforms 37, 38 and 39) - Location on the map and Ljubljana Bus Station Map  Please accept our apologies for any inconvenience caused, and thank you for your understanding.  potniski.sz.si/info

alerts.headerText: OBVESTILO: Združeni vlaki iz/do Zidanega Mosta (do nadaljnjega).
alerts.descriptionText: ZIDANI MOST - LJUBLJANA:  Garnitura vlaka RG 619 iz Maribora se v Zidanem Mostu združi z garnituro vlaka RG 630 iz Dobove in nadaljuje vožnjo proti Ljubljani. Prestop potnikov iz vlaka RG 619 na vlak RG 630 za potovanje v smeri Ljubljane tako ni potreben.  Garnitura vlaka RG 632 iz Dobove se v Zidanem Mostu združi z garnituro vlaka RG 607 iz Maribora in nadaljuje vožnjo proti Ljubljani. Prestop potnikov iz vlaka RG 632 na vlak RG 607 za potovanje v smeri Ljubljane tako ni potreben.  LJUBLJANA - ZIDANI MOST:  Garnitura vlaka RG 618 iz Ljubljane do Zidanega Mosta vozi združeno z garnituro vlaka RG 631 (Ljubljana - Zidani Most - Dobova). Na postaji Zidani Most se obe omenjeni garnituri ločita. Prva potuje v smeri Dobove (vlak RG 631), druga pa nadaljuje vožnjo v smeri Maribora (vlak RG 618). Prestop potnikov tako ni potreben, bodite pa pozorni na izbiro ustrezne garniture za želeno smer potovanja (prva garnitura: Smer Dobova, druga garnitura: Smer Maribor). Za pomoč in usmeritve vam je na voljo naše osebje.   Hvala za razumevanje.   potniski.sz.si/info  Na portalu MOJ VLAK se lahko naročite na samodejno obveščanje (prek brezplačnih sporočil SMS) o dogodkih na progi in morebitnih spremembah voženj vlakov v notranjem prometu. Več informacij.

alerts.headerText: NOTICE: Merged trains to/from Zidani Most (until further notice).
alerts.descriptionText: ZIDANI MOST - LJUBLJANA:  The train set of RG 619 from Maribor joins the train set of RG 630 from Dobova at Zidani Most and continues towards Ljubljana. Therefore, passengers from train RG 619 do not need to transfer to train RG 630 for travel towards Ljubljana.   The train set of RG 632 from Dobova joins the train set of RG 607 from Maribor at Zidani Most and continues towards Ljubljana. Therefore, passengers from train RG 632 do not need to transfer to train RG 607 for travel towards Ljubljana.  LJUBLJANA - ZIDANI MOST:   The train set RG 618 from Ljubljana to Zidani Most runs merged together with the train set RG 631 (Ljubljana - Zidani Most - Dobova). At the Zidani Most station, both mentioned train sets separate. The first one travels in the direction of Dobova (train RG 631), while the second one continues its journey in the direction of Maribor (train RG 618). Passengers do not need to change trains, but please be careful to choose the appropriate train set for the desired direction of travel (first train set: Direction Dobova, second train set: Direction Maribor). Our staff is available to help and guide you.  Thank you for your understanding.  potniski.sz.si/info

alerts.headerText: DELA NA PROGI: Prenova in gradnja železniških postaj Brezovica, Vnanje Gorice in Preserje.
alerts.descriptionText: Od začetka leta 2026 poteka prenova preostalega odseka proge Ljubljana - Borovnica, prenova postaj Brezovica in Preserje ter gradnja novega postajališča Vnanje Gorice. V navedenem času so možne občasne ovire v železniškem prometu zaradi upočasnjene vožnje mimo gradbišča ali zapore posameznih tirov ter prilagojeno vodenje potnikov na postajah. Več informacij o projektu in obsegu del lahko najdete na www.krajsamorazdalje.si.  Na postajah Brezovica in Preserje bodite pozorni na spremenjene dostope na perone tekom gradnje. Za pomoč in usmeritve pri vstopu/izstopu vlaka se lahko obrnete na naše osebje.  Za gradnjo, obnovo in vzdrževanje javne železniške infrastrukture je pristojna Direkcija RS za infrastrukturo.  Potnikom se zahvaljujemo za razumevanje.  infrastruktura.sz.si

alerts.headerText: TRACK WORKS: Renovation and construction of Brezovica, Vnanje Gorice, and Preserje railway stations.
alerts.descriptionText: Since the beginning of 2026, the renovation of the remaining section of the Ljubljana - Borovnica line, the renovation of Brezovica and Preserje stations, and the construction of the new Vnanje Gorice station have been underway. During this time, occasional disruptions in rail service are possible due to speed restrictions passing the construction site or closure of individual tracks as well as adjusted passenger guidance at the station. More information about the project and the scope of the work can be found at www.krajsamorazdalje.si.  At Brezovica and Preserje stations, please be aware of altered platform access during construction. For assistance and guidance when boarding or disembarking the train, you can ask our staff.  Slovenian Infrastructure Agency is responsible for the construction, renovation and maintenance of public railway infrastructure.  We thank passengers for their understanding.  infrastruktura.sz.si
